requirements.description: SET <key> <value> stores value
requirements.notes: _set() L127-146: parses args, validates key/value, stores in self._data

requirements.description: GET <key> returns value or ERR key_not_found
requirements.notes: _get() L150-161: validates key, checks existence, returns value or ERR key_not_found

requirements.description: DEL <key> removes key or ERR key_not_found
requirements.notes: _del() L165-175: checks existence, deletes key+expiry, returns OK or ERR key_not_found

requirements.description: KEYS returns all keys one per line, terminated by END
requirements.notes: _keys() L179-182: joins sorted keys with newline, appends END

requirements.description: COUNT returns COUNT <n>
requirements.notes: _count() L186-188: returns COUNT {len(self._data)}

requirements.description: EXISTS <key> returns TRUE or FALSE
requirements.notes: _exists() L192-199: returns TRUE if key present and not expired, else FALSE

requirements.description: FLUSH removes all keys, returns OK
requirements.notes: _flush() L203-206: clears self._data and self._expiry, returns OK

requirements.description: SET and DEL return OK on success
requirements.notes: _set() L146 returns 'OK', _del() L175 returns 'OK'

requirements.description: Unknown command returns ERR unknown_command
requirements.notes: execute() L76-77 returns ERR unknown_command for unrecognized cmd, L81-82 catches exceptions

requirements.description: Max key length enforced, rejected with ERR key_too_long
requirements.notes: _validate_key() L108-112 checks len(key) > max_key_length (default 64)

requirements.description: Max value size enforced, rejected with ERR value_too_large
requirements.notes: _validate_value() L114-118 checks len(value) > max_value_size (default 1024)

requirements.description: Max keys enforced, SET at capacity returns ERR store_full (update allowed)
requirements.notes: _set() L141-142: only rejects new keys when len(self._data) >= max_keys

requirements.description: MSET <k1> <v1> ... atomic multi-set, returns OK <n>
requirements.notes: _mset() L210-236: validates all pairs first, then commits atomically

requirements.description: MGET <k1> ... returns values, NIL for missing, terminated by END
requirements.notes: _mget() L240-258: returns values or NIL, appends END marker

requirements.description: TTL <key> returns remaining seconds, -1, or ERR key_not_found
requirements.notes: _ttl() L262-278: computes remaining=int(expiry-time.time()) or returns -1

requirements.description: SETEX <key> <seconds> <value> with expiry; expired keys treated as nonexistent
requirements.notes: _setex() L282-306 sets expiry; _is_expired() L86-93 cleans on access

requirements.description: APPEND <key> <value> appends or creates, returns OK <new_length>
requirements.notes: _append() L310-334: appends to existing or creates new, returns OK {len(new_value)}

requirements.description: RENAME <old> <new> renames key, OK or ERR key_not_found
requirements.notes: _rename() L338-357: moves value and expiry to new key, returns OK

requirements.description: TYPE <key> returns STRING, INTEGER, or ERR key_not_found
requirements.notes: _type() L361-378: int(value) check returns INTEGER, else STRING

requirements.description: DUMP returns all key=value pairs, terminated by END
requirements.notes: _dump() L382-386: iterates sorted keys, formats k=v, appends END
